prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1207; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle moved into their lane during a lane change. Reported left knee pain and swelling are consistent with the mechanism of this type of impact. Over the course of fifteen visits, care followed a conventional progression of physical examination, imaging review, targeted physical therapy, and home exercise instruction. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Several examination findings, including localized tenderness and a modest effusion, support an acute soft tissue injury to the knee. Other ligament and meniscal stability tests were within normal limits. The patient reports a remote, minor strain in the same region years ago, which resolved completely without lasting limitation and does not appear to account for the present complaints. Billed services correspond to the visits documented, with no duplicated or repeated charges identified in the record.
